UserAuthProfile.title: UserAuthProfile
UserAuthProfile.description: User authentication and login profile details (First Name, Last Name, Logged-in Phone Number, Verified Email)

phone.description: 10-digit verified mobile number used for login

phoneVerified.description: Whether the mobile number was verified via 6-digit OTP

emailVerified.description: Whether the email address was verified via 6-digit OTP

firebaseUid.description: Firebase Auth UID associated with the session

lastLoginAt.description: ISO timestamp of last OTP login

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last profile update

/users/{phone}.description: Stores user authentication and profile details keyed by 10-digit verified phone number
